captions.tiktok: Allah is al-Wadud, the Most Loving. His care for you is greater than a mother's for her child, and however far you have wandered, He loves for you to return. Qur'an 11:90, 85:14.
captions.shorts: Al-Wadud, the Most Loving - His love reaches you and asks nothing first. Qur'an 11:90 + 85:14.
captions.reels: He is more merciful to you than a mother to her child. Allah, al-Wadud, the Most Loving.

segments.text: There is a love that asks nothing from you first, and never runs out.
One of the names of Allah is al-Wadud. It does not only mean that He loves. It means His love reaches you.
Picture a mother with her newborn, holding the child to her chest, unable to let it come to any harm.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, once pointed to such a mother, and said something we should never forget.
Allah is more merciful to His servants than she is to her own child.
Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate.
However far you have wandered, He loves for you to return. He is the Forgiving, the Most Loving.
